other_voting_restriction: A separate professional-investor eligibility restriction applies to voting.
poa_required: A formal power of attorney is a mandatory prerequisite for this account to vote.
registration_required: The account must register its voting participation before it may cast votes.
securities_lending_recall_required: Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.
share_blocking: Submitting proxy votes prevents disposal of the corresponding securities until the meeting concludes.
split_voting_restricted: A holder may choose one direction for all shares or split them freely; no uniform-vote requirement applies.
votability: The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
